### convention: no-dco-on-plans
description: The plans lineage takes no DCO sign-off, restated by a test.
scope: plans and plans-tooling branches
trigger: committing on a plans-lineage branch
status: probation
origin: observed practice, not yet ratified

This convention runs to end of file in the fixture, so replacing it proves
the tool handles a section with no following heading at all.
